name: expense-webapp

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Calls the Expense Claims API for all claim data, approvals, rejections, receipt URLs, and payroll export.

dependencies.name: thunder-auth
dependencies.description: Signs the user in via OIDC + PKCE in the browser and attaches the resulting bearer token to API calls.

description: The single web surface for employees, managers, and finance: submitting and tracking claims, reviewing and deciding on direct reports' claims, and exporting approved claims to payroll. Renders a distinct set of screens per signed-in role. Holds no business logic or credentials of its own — all data and decisions come from expense-api.
